review: Nine candidates opened and their captures visually inspected over more than three minutes; incomplete image loads are explicitly noted. Primary/secondary selected from successfully retrieved official product screenshots.

candidates.name: Things
candidates.decision: Product screenshot directly reviewed in things-app.png; quieter grouping; secondary comparison

candidates.name: Bear
candidates.decision: Product screenshot directly reviewed in bear-app.jpg; clear pane hierarchy; rejected dark navigation as mismatched

candidates.name: Craft
candidates.decision: Marketing page visually reviewed; editorial rather than employee workflow; rejected as primary

candidates.name: Agenda
candidates.decision: Page visually reviewed; product images failed to load; unsuitable as a primary reference

candidates.name: Fantastical
candidates.decision: Page visually reviewed; product screenshot fetch returned403; not used as visual authority

candidates.name: BusyCal
candidates.decision: Product screenshot directly reviewed in busycal-app.png; dense calendar; rejected as primary for readability request

candidates.name: Raycast
candidates.decision: Page visually reviewed; dark marketing composition and launcher do not match this task

candidates.name: Reeder
candidates.decision: Product screenshot directly reviewed in reeder-app.png; PRIMARY: generous list rows, readable text, sidebar/list/content separation

candidates.name: Linear
candidates.decision: Browser navigation timed out; partial page screenshot visually reviewed; rejected as primary

fidelityMap.hierarchy: Readable page title, separated primary content and quieter utility areas
fidelityMap.typography: User-requested comfortable scale: body16px, nav/control15px, section18px, page32px; adaptation, not measured source values
fidelityMap.panes: Keep information panes in layout flow with bounded independent scroll; map and bookings do not overlap
fidelityMap.palette: Existing OCD macOS neutral tokens and green action accent
fidelityMap.motion: Existing160ms fade and3px shift; no bouncing or blocked interaction
fidelityMap.assets: Official screenshots retained only as research evidence; none used in product UI
